wapp_host.activity.none.help: Likes, replies and reposts of your posts land here.
wapp_host.block.title: Block {name}?
wapp_host.block.body: Their messages are dropped as they arrive and this conversation is removed. Nothing is sent — they are not told. You can undo this from the wapp's Blocked list.
wapp_host.chat.no_address: No messaging address known for {target} yet — they need to be heard on the network first.
wapp_host.file.too_large: {name} is larger than {mb} MB. Share it from a folder instead.
wapp_host.forward.title: Forward to
wapp_host.forward.hint: Search contacts, or type a callsign / #group
wapp_host.geochat.title: Geo Chat
wapp_host.key.import.title: Import signing key
wapp_host.key.import.body: Paste your nsec1… private key. This will create a new profile and set it as the active signing identity.
wapp_host.maps.no_location: Could not get your location (check GPS + permission)
wapp_host.nostr.blossom.help: Images in the feed are fetched from these by their sha256, and anything you share is uploaded to them. Tried in order.
wapp_host.nostr.blossom.none: None — shared media will not reach anyone over the internet, and images posted by others will not load.
wapp_host.nostr.relays.help: Where posts come from and go to. wss:// over the internet, rns:// over Reticulum, or this device.
wapp_host.picker.tap: Tap a file in the list to select it
wapp_host.picture.too_large: {name} is too large for a picture.
wapp_host.picture.unreadable: That picture could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
wapp_host.post.delete_all.title: Delete for everyone?
wapp_host.post.delete_all.body: Everyone who holds this post is asked to delete it. Those who honour the request lose the words for good, and so do you.
wapp_host.reach.waiting: Not reachable — the message waits for them
wapp_host.service.label: Internet without internet
wapp_host.store.loading.help: Fetching index.json from your repository. Use Refresh above if the list stays empty.
wapp_host.store.no_repo.help: Set a repository URL or local path in the Settings tab, then pull to refresh to see the wapps available for install.
wapp_host.store.sources.dup: This repository is already in the list.
wapp_host.store.sources.dup_as: This repository is already in the list (as {url}).
wapp_host.store.sources.help: The store reads its catalog from every repository listed here; https://xprs.dev/apps is the one it starts with. A new entry is checked first: it has to answer with a catalog.json or an index.json.
wapp_host.store.sources.invalid: Could not find a valid index.json at this URL. Check the address and try again.
wapp_host.store.sources.none: No repositories yet. Add one below to see wapps in the Store tab.
wapp_host.store.sources.url_help: The store will try <url>/wapps/index.json first, then <url>/index.json. For local paths, pass the directory that contains the index.
wapp_host.store.uninstall.title: Uninstall {name}?
wapp_host.store.uninstall.body: This removes the wapp from this device. You can reinstall it anytime from the store.
wapp_host.video.no_mediapack.help: Install the Mediapack wapp from the Wapp Store to play video.
wapp_host.video.none.help: Use the menu (top-right) to pick a video.
wapp_host.video.unsupported: Video not supported on this platform.
wapp_host.video.unsupported.help: No media backend is available here.
